source_evidence: The fee that you pay for this advice is typically based on the value of all of the assets held in your account with the adviser.
answer: When comparing investment advisers, ask how they are paid. Their advice fee is typically based on the value of assets in your account, and you may also pay other account and investment-related fees or costs. To learn about an adviser’s qualifications, ask about their experience, education, and recent employment history. You can also ask whether they or their firm have been disciplined by a regulator.
